history.value: The sim chooser (--rewards sim --sim-boss) scores an option by one-turn trial fights against the next floor plus the boss at post-rest HP, weighted alike, so it cannot see the HP the path's elites take (cause/boss-deaths: 17.3 and 13.8 HP per elite) unless the next floor is one. A card that pays at the boss and costs on the way is overpicked once the trial fighter plays it right: with the turn-start leaf Demon Form picks rise 0.17 to 0.49 of offers and the extra picks lose -0.115 (0.066) clears, deaths moving from the boss to the second elite, cancelling the fighting gain (measurement/turn-start-leaf@headline). So a fighter repair of a card does not reach own-pick headline reads through this chooser, and the trial-fight mismatch on cards that pay later is worth about nothing under this horizon. Exit: a chooser whose horizon holds the next elite (backlog elite-horizon-chooser, waits for Act 1's cards) reads level or worse than the sim chooser with the leaf on.
